description: Paid Parking (Last 48 Hours) is a dataset listed in City of Seattle open data portal (cos-data.seattle.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Seattle. The City of Seattle has created an on-street paid parking occupancy data set and is providing access to this data set for public use for research and entrepreneurial purposes under the City’s Open Data Program. Coverage: Seattle. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are sdot, curbspace, parking, pay stations. The table has 12 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-cos-data-seattle-gov-portal.
